model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тези линейни графуми даваат ясна представленост на промените в стречните структури на спектрометричената картина (SDPA) незалежно от точки меры. Площата (X-ас) показва количества отклонения на фактична поретка, сaying là presents diminishing returns на преуложение над точка мере. Площата (Y-ас), допълнително, представя шестчиената структура класиер, като двуматрицно променя по мере എന്തо събирамените данни от базата на данни (включително страницata и живите данни).

Всяка линия в графиката също отговаря на различни аспекти на SDPA, и всеки показва колко изгледно може информацията да представи специфични своите други в контекста на тристотκια.

model_annotations.English: The line plot titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" aims to illustrate the change in sparsity ratio across different layers in a computational model, using three different scenarios: before gate, after gate, and after average gate. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 22, indicating the layers of the model. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, representing the proportion of non-zero values in the model's output. Three lines are plotted: the solid blue line represents the sparsity ratio after the gate, with an average value of 0.44, the dashed orange line represents the sparsity ratio after the average gate, with an average value of 0.33, and the dash-dot green line represents the sparsity ratio before the gate, with an average value of 0.03. The solid blue line starts near 1.0 at layer 0 and shows a general decline with slight fluctuations as it moves to layer 22. The dash-dot green line starts at approximately 0.03 at layer 0 and gradually decreases to near 0.0 by layer 22. The dashed orange line starts at around 0.5 at layer 0 and also decreases towards zero but with more pronounced fluctuations. Throughout the plot, no section references any axes together, as there is only one set of axes shared between the three lines.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm präsentiert die Varianzabweichung der Schrägplattenanzug-Promotoren-Ausgabe (SDPA) im Vergleich zu doppelgipfel-Schraubkreis-Söldnern (massen) unter Verwendung von Schrägplattenanzugs-Feldwire.
